title: ABCF1-K430-Lactylation promotes HCC malignant progression via transcriptional activation of HIF1 signaling pathway.
authors: Hong, Han; Han, Hexu; Wang, Lei; Cao, Wen; Hu, Minjie; Li, Jindong; Wang, Jiawei; Yang, Yijin; Xu, XiaoYong; Li, Gaochao; Zhang, Zixiang; Zhang, Changhe; Xu, Minhui; Wang, Honggang; Wang, Qiang; Yuan, Yin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ABCF1乳酸化修饰通过结合KDM3A启动子激活HIF1信号促进肝癌进展，涉及蛋白-DNA结合机制，但以湿实验为主，仅含分子对接，AI/物理模拟方法深度有限。
abstract: Lysine lactylation plays critical roles in various diseases, including cancer. Our previous study showed that lactylation of non-histone ABCF1 may be involved in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) progression. In this study, we evaluated the prognostic value of ABCF1-K430la in HCC using immunohistochemical staining and performed amino acid point mutations, multi-omics crossover, and biochemical experiments to investigate its biological role and underlying mechanism. Additionally, we performed molecular docking on lactylation sites. ABCF1-K430la was highly expressed in HCC tissues and correlated with poor patient prognosis. Functionally, ABCF1-K430la promoted HCC growth and lung metastasis. Mechanistically, upon lactylation, E2 ubiquitin ligase activity of ABCF1 remained unaffected, and ABCF1 entered the nucleus, bound to the KDM3A promoter to upregulate its expression, and activated the KDM3A-H3K9me2-HIF1A axis, challenging the notion that ABCF1 functions exclusively in cytoplasmic protein translation. Notably, we discovered the existence of a lactate-ABCF1(430Kla)-HIF1A-lactate in HCC. A small-molecule drug screen targeting ABCF1-K430la revealed that tubuloside A inhibits ABCF1-K430la and suppresses HCC development. These findings demonstrate that elevated ABCF1-K430la expression promotes HCC development, suggesting it as a potential prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target for HCC.
abstract_zh: 赖氨酸乳酸化在包括癌症在内的多种疾病中发挥关键作用。我们先前的研究表明，非组蛋白ABCF1的乳酸化可能参与肝细胞癌（HCC）的进展。在本研究中，我们通过免疫组织化学染色评估了ABCF1-K430la在HCC中的预后价值，并进行了氨基酸点突变、多组学交叉及生物化学实验，以探究其生物学作用及潜在机制。此外，我们对乳酸化位点进行了分子对接。ABCF1-K430la在HCC组织中高表达，并与患者不良预后相关。功能上，ABCF1-K430la促进了HCC的生长和肺转移。机制上，乳酸化后，ABCF1的E2泛素连接酶活性保持不变，ABCF1进入细胞核，结合KDM3A启动子以上调其表达，并激活KDM3A-H3K9me2-HIF1A轴，这挑战了ABCF1仅参与细胞质蛋白翻译的观点。值得注意的是，我们发现了HCC中乳酸-ABCF1(430Kla)-HIF1A-乳酸回路的存在。针对ABCF1-K430la的小分子药物筛选显示，管花苷A抑制ABCF1-K430la并抑制HCC发展。这些发现表明，ABCF1-K430la表达升高促进HCC发展，提示其可作为HCC的潜在预后生物标志物和治疗靶点。
